SELECT
	AliasName = T.AliasName,
	CustomerName=T.CustomerName,
	NTN = T.NTN,
	NetAmount=SUM(T.NetAmount),
	TaxCategory = T.TaxCategory,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = T.AdvanceTaxPerc,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = SUM(T.AdvanceTaxAmt)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		TType='Sales',
		Date=P.Date,
		InvoiceCode='SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.SaleInvCode, 10))),
		AliasName = A.AliasName,
		CustomerName=A.Name,
		NTN = S.NTNNo,
		NetAmount=P.InvTotal,
		TaxCategory = TC.Name,
		AdvanceTaxPerc = TC.TaxPerc,
		AdvanceTaxAmt = P.AdvanceTaxAmt
	FROM
		SaleLedger P, Accounts A, Customer S, TaxCategory TC
	WHERE
		:ai_allcust=0 AND
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		P.CustCode IN (:ai_Custcode) AND
